name: CoordinateSource
description: Data source of the directional survey. The ENV Phantoms algorithm solves the problem of missing directional surveys by building synthetic directional surveys (phantoms) for wells missing in our coverage areas. Given a surface hole location (SHL), a bottom-hole location (BHL), a lateral length and a true vertical depth (TVD), a set of prospective phantoms can be drawn and assessed to determine which well path is most likely. These well paths are then used in the spacing model to ensure that the system the spacing model is looking to describe is fully defined from the beginning.

name: Country
description: Abbreviation of the country the well is located in.

name: County
description: Name of the county the well is located in.

name: Date
description: Date the Survey Was Performed

name: DatumOriginal
description: Reference system against which original positional measurements are made for computing locations.

name: DatumTransformed
description: Reference system against which positional measurements are made for computing locations.

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted.

name: ElevationGL_FT
description: Elevation to ground level in feet.

name: ENVBasin
description: Name of the basin the well is located in.

name: ENVInterval
description: ENV Interval is assigned when a well is located within an ENV Play Shapefile boundary AND meets specific geo-gridding, date, trajectory and/or formation criteria to be considered prospective within that given play file boundary.

name: ENVPlay
description: ENV Play as defined by a well's location within an Enverus-defined Play Shapefile AND meets criteria to be assigned an ENV Interval within that play.

name: ENVRegion
description: ENV Region as defined by a well's location within one of nine ENV Region Shapefiles. ENV Region inclusively covers North America.

name: Geometry_Line
description: Represents the Geometry of the wellbore as a linestring.

name: GeomSHL_Point
description: Geometry representation of the well surface location in 2D

name: GLElevationFromPlat
description: Ground level elevation.

name: GridConvergence
description: The horizontal angle at a place between true north and grid north

name: GridConvergenceSource
description: Source Of Grid Convergence Value - Document Or Calculated

name: KellyBushing
description: An adaptor that connects the rotary table to the kelly.

name: Latitude
description: Latitude Location Of Surface Hole As Displayed In Prism

name: Latitude_BH
description: Latitude of the last station point from the directional survey.

name: LatitudeOriginal
description: The original latitude of the well.

name: Longitude
description: Longitude Location Of Surface Hole As Displayed In Prism

name: Longitude_BH
description: Longitude of the last station point from the directional survey.

name: LongitudeOriginal
description: The original longitude of the well.

name: MagneticNorth
description: Magnetic North.

name: MapZone
description: The map projection of the directional survey.

name: MapZoneSource
description: Source of the map zone is DOCUMENT if the value came from the survey, and CALCULATED if it was calculated based on it’s location.

name: MaxMeasuredDepth_FT
description: Maximum Measured Depth from the directional survey in feet.

name: MaxTrueVerticalDepth_FT
description: Maximum True Vertical Depth from the directional survey in feet.

name: NorthReference
description: North Reference.

name: NorthReferenceTransformed
description: The applied north reference value.

name: RigName

name: StateProvince
description: State abbreviation where the well is located.

name: SurveyCompany
description: Company that created survey.

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: VerticalReference
description: The starting elevation for the directional survey. This will typically be the ground level plus Kelly bushing height, Drilling floor height, or stated reference elevation.

name: WellboreName
description: Name of the wellbore as it appears on a survey.

name: WellboreType
description: The directional survey measurement type, typically either easured while drilling (MWD) or Gyroscopic (Gyro).

name: WellID
description: Enverus-generated unique well identifier.
